prompts:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: separated rig parts sheet for 2D skeletal animation in Rive.
Use the attached DARK-BROWN HEADBAND red panda as the EXACT identity and design reference. Same face silhouette, markings, colors, proportions and flat vector style. This output is NOT a pose sheet: it is an atlas of detached component artwork ONLY, no assembled characters.
High resolution square canvas, preferably 2048x2048. Plain uniform flat warm off-white background. Arrange components in SIX clean horizontal rows with evenly spaced cells, generous clear gutters and NO overlaps. Parts retain correct relative scale for assembly; do not enlarge small facial features to body size. Front view, neutral orientation. Anatomical left/right: left arm will wear the orange wristband. Every individual component must be fully drawn, including rounded hidden joint ends, the full top of torso under head, the roots of ears under head, and joint overlap extensions. No holes, missing slices or accidental clipping.
Exact inventory and layout from left to right:
ROW 1: FOUR isolated components: (1) front-facing head base with rust-red fur and existing cream cheek/muzzle markings, but NO eyes, NO pupils, NO eyebrows, NO nose, NO mouth, NO ears and NO headband; (2) whole left ear including cream rim, dark inner ear and complete rounded root; (3) whole mirrored right ear with same construction; (4) dark chocolate-brown headband alone, full shape on blank background.
ROW 2: SIX isolated PAIRS: open eyes pair; half-closed eyes pair; closed eyes pair represented as downward curving closed-lid arcs; happy eyes pair represented as upward arching inverted-U arcs; wide eyes pair; a separate pair of BLACK PUPILS WITH WHITE HIGHLIGHTS. The open/half-closed/wide eye assets consist of eye whites and eyelids WITHOUT pupils, because the pupils are separate rig pieces. Two eyes/pupils per pair, separated, each pair separated from adjacent pairs.
ROW 3: FOUR isolated components/groups: pair of neutral cream eyebrow spots; pair of raised cream eyebrow spots; pair of worried-tilted cream eyebrow spots with inner ends higher; one separate dark nose.
ROW 4: FIVE isolated mouth assets: simple smile; open laugh mouth with tongue; small round O mouth; flat closed mouth; slight frown. No noses or heads in this row.
ROW 5: SIX isolated body components: torso with the original rust-red chest bib, full rounded shoulder/neck area, NO arms, legs or tail; left upper arm only; left forearm and attached lighter brown paw WITH one bright orange #FF7A1F wristband; right upper arm only; right forearm and attached lighter brown paw WITHOUT wristband; left leg with attached lighter brown foot. Arms are detached smooth dark-brown capsules with full rounded joint ends. Upper arms contain no paws. Forearms contain paws. Legs include full rounded hip insertion hidden areas.
ROW 6: SIX isolated components: right leg with foot; followed by FIVE sequential tail segments ordered ROOT to TIP. These five pieces, when placed end-to-end, must reconstruct ONE large tapered bushy striped red-panda tail with the same proportions as the reference. They are NOT five whole tails: root, lower-middle, middle, upper-middle, rounded terminal tip. Four middle joining cross-sections must match in width and stripe color; extend hidden overlap ends fully. Continuous alternating rust-red and darker rust tail bands must align across joins. Keep each piece separate with visible off-white gaps.
Total 31 cells/groups, including paired facial features. Absolutely NO text, labels, numbers, grid lines, guide marks, skeleton bones, shadows or assembled character. Flat uniform solid fills, simple rounded shapes, crisp clean vector-style edges. No textures, fur strands, gradients, lighting or 3D rendering. Preserve reference cream markings and rust-red body color, dark-brown headband and limbs, lighter brown paws. Orange is only on the left forearm wristband.

Correct the attached RIG PARTS SHEET. Keep the same six-row inventory, same layout, colors and character identity, same plain OFF-WHITE background, no text. This is flat 2D cutout artwork, not 3D parts.
Required fixes:
- ROW 5 first item TORSO: completely REMOVE both attached arms/sleeves. Torso must be a single smooth dark-brown pear-shaped body silhouette with the rust-red chest bib and a fully drawn rounded TOP under the head. No limb projections, no arm lines, no flat chopped neck stump.
- All separate arm/leg pieces: eliminate light-colored oval cut surfaces at joints. These are flat 2D shapes, not cylinders. Upper arms are plain solid dark-brown capsules with round ends of the SAME color, no discs or sockets. Forearms have dark-brown rounded top, light brown paws. Feet light brown. Exactly one orange wristband, on left forearm.
- ROW 6 after the leg: replace the five 3D barrel-shaped objects with FIVE FLAT adjacent slices of ONE 2D striped tail silhouette, ordered root to tip. Imagine the long bushy tail seen FLAT FROM THE SIDE, its length horizontal, divided into five successive sections by four vertical cuts, then slide those sections apart with off-white gaps. Narrow rounded root at LEFT; widens through second section to middle; narrows toward rounded RIGHT tip. Match the heights at facing boundaries exactly so sliding together reconstructs a continuous silhouette. Alternating rust and dark-rust stripe fills are drawn across one tail before separating; stripe colors at each matching join must agree. No endcaps, no elliptical side faces, no concentric rings, no 3D shading, no barrel or cone shapes. All five are flat 2D silhouette strips. Fully paint small hidden overlap extensions the matching stripe color.
- ROW 2 second pair: remove black pupils from half-closed eye whites. Keep rust eyelids and white lower halves. Pupils exist ONLY as separate black highlighted pair at far right.
- ROW 2 happy fourth pair: simple black inverted-U arcs only; no colored lids.
- ROW 2 fifth wide-eye pair: visibly larger round white eyes than first neutral open pair.
- ROW 3 middle raised cream eyebrow pair: position both spots higher at same angle as neutral; worried pair remains diagonally tilted with inner ends raised.
- ROW 4 first smile: remove nose and vertical nose stalk; mouth line only. Third small O mouth: simple small dark circular O without tongue. Fourth flat mouth: perfectly straight short dark line.
Keep first-row head, ears, and headband intact. Keep all artwork uniformly flat filled with NO shadows, NO textures, NO gradients. Do not add text or assembled character.

Clean up this exact rig parts atlas. Replace the entire black/transparent/noisy background with a perfectly uniform solid warm OFF-WHITE #FAF7EF. Remove ALL red/yellow/white pixel noise and edge artifacts outside the components. Keep every component fully opaque with crisp clean edges. Preserve all six rows, every part and every position, colors and proportions, separated flat tail slices, detached torso without arms, separate limbs, facial features, ears and headband. No changes to the artwork except clean edges and flat uniform fills. No background shadows or textures or gradients. No transparency, no black backdrop, no noise, no text. Final is clean flat 2D vector-style parts on opaque light ivory background.
